features.quote: Maximum 25 iterations or until the model explicitly outputs a termination token sequence
Cap per-run token budget at 180 k tokens. Auto-abort and mark as "token exhaustion" if exceeded.
features.justification_quote: Record token counts per turn and cumulative cost.

features.quote: If the model attempts to rewrite the same file in three consecutive turns with no test improvement, a one-sentence observation ("No change in test results") is injected once; after that, silence.
